themes.name: Critical materials and geopolitics
themes.what: China extended its pause on the gallium, germanium and antimony export ban to the US until about Jan 27, 2027, instead of letting it end Nov 27 (Wall Street Journal; Bloomberg; BigGo Finance, Nov 24). The Nov 27 deadline that this map has tracked since early November is gone for now.
themes.for_you: Less urgency for US antimony and gallium supply in the next two months, which takes some air out of the scarcity story for UAMY. MP, UAMY and USAR still have no buy point (lower highs and lower lows). No action; the next date that matters is late January.
